title: Boiling Liquids - Max Pumping Flow Velocities
description: Recommended max flow velocity on the delivery (pressure) side when pumping boiling liquids.

outputs.label: Recommended Max Flow Velocity
outputs.formula: inputs.pipe_diameter_inches < 1.5 ? 1 : inputs.pipe_diameter_inches < 2.5 ? 1.1 : inputs.pipe_diameter_inches < 3.5 ? 1.15 : inputs.pipe_diameter_inches < 5 ? 1.25 : inputs.pipe_diameter_inches < 7 ? 1.5 : inputs.pipe_diameter_inches < 9 ? 1.75 : 2

outputs.label: Recommended Max Flow Velocity (Imperial)
outputs.formula: inputs.pipe_diameter_inches < 1.5 ? 3.5 : inputs.pipe_diameter_inches < 2.5 ? 3.6 : inputs.pipe_diameter_inches < 3.5 ? 3.8 : inputs.pipe_diameter_inches < 5 ? 4 : inputs.pipe_diameter_inches < 7 ? 4.7 : inputs.pipe_diameter_inches < 9 ? 5.5 : 6.5
